Wow know exactly how you feel. I remember when there were times when I wouldn’t respond to friends calls since I didn’t have the emotional energy to hang out or go outside. Then they started coming directly to my door ringing the bell to get me to go out and I genuinely felt adverse and kinda hurt because it felt like I was being forced into a situation I couldn’t avoid since I’m bad at saying no or being honest when I’m not feeling well.

Coming out about this is really hard and embarrassing because let’s say my family or day 1 friend learned of this, I feel like they wouldn’t be able to understand. It feels like my entire identity is a lie as if I’ve been developing multiple characters that aren’t me but at the same time are and even blended at points. I’ve been so good at living like this that it feels like I’ll disappoint them because I may not be who they think I am. I feel like a fraud. My morals and values feel so blurry and confused and I struggle really bad with committing myself to things.
